caseNameFull: Roberts v. Florida Noland v. North Carolina Koon v. Florida Alderman v. Georgia Ford v. Georgia

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Fla.; Gen. Ct. Justice, Super. Ct. Div., Mecklenburg County, N. C.; Sup. Ct. Fla.; Sup. Ct. Ga.; and Sup. Ct. Ga. Certiorari denied.

opinions.author: Brennan
opinions.text:
Justice Brennan

and Justice Marshall, dissenting.

Adhering to our views that the death penalty is in all circumstances cruel and unusual punishment prohibited by the Eighth and Fourteenth Amendments, Gregg v. Georgia, 428 U. S. 153, 227, 231 (1976), we would grant certiorari and vacate the death sentences in these cases.
